responsibility: Implements array lowering, scalarization, and descriptor access for the GENERIC translation phase. It builds and queries array descriptors, creates scalarization state chains and temporaries, handles array constructor and array-function transfers, manages dependencies and copy semantics, and supports coarray, optional-argument, and elemental-function lowering across the trans-* subsystem.
same_name_distinction: Contains the array-lowering implementation for the trans subsystem: descriptor field access, scalarization-state construction and walking, loop setup, temporaries, array constructor handling, and elemental/array function traversal. The paired header is only the interface used by other trans-* files to call those services.
